headerText: Spend your {budget} trait points. Drawbacks pay points back.
incompatibleNote: Clashes with a trait you have already taken.
unaffordableNote: Not enough trait points left for this one.
archetypeHint: Pick a ready-made build. Switch to Detailed mode to change it trait by trait.

hardy_brawn.name: Hardy Brawn
hardy_brawn.description: Plain physical stock: built thick, built warm, built to keep going.

nimble_hands.name: Nimble Hands
nimble_hands.description: Quick, even-handed and awake early. Good hands for any trade.

bright_mind.name: Bright Mind
bright_mind.description: A studied head that remembers everything and boasts about none of it.

natural_charmer.name: Natural Charmer
natural_charmer.description: Beautiful, outgoing and easy to like, with a romantic streak.

lucky_wanderer.name: Lucky Wanderer
lucky_wanderer.description: An honest traveller the road keeps being kind to.

steady_hand.name: Steady Hand
steady_hand.description: Guarded, unshakeable and loyal. Nothing flashy, nothing that breaks.

frontline_soldier.name: Frontline Soldier
frontline_soldier.description: Drilled behind a shield and used to holding a line.

blade_duelist.name: Blade Duelist
blade_duelist.description: A fast, proud, straight-talking sword in a formal fight.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: Huge, furious and glad of the pain. Attack is the only plan.

martial_artist.name: Martial Artist
martial_artist.description: Monastery-trained, weaponless and finished with the training.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.description: A gun-happy marksman with reflexes to match the aim.

ranger_archer.name: Ranger Archer
ranger_archer.description: A bow, a trail and a camp struck before sunrise.

knight_errant.name: Knight Errant
knight_errant.description: Born to a name, loyal to it, and best seen from a saddle.

bar_brawler.name: Bar Brawler
bar_brawler.description: Heavy, loud and blunt, and happiest with fists.

war_tactician.name: War Tactician
war_tactician.description: A veteran who reads the field and lets others do the running.

master_thief.name: Master Thief
master_thief.description: Fast fingers that cannot stop themselves, and nerves that never settle.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: A nameless, feelingless professional who works at night.

street_urchin.name: Street Urchin
street_urchin.description: Raised by the gutter, schooled in picking pockets, never in letters.

con_artist.name: Con Artist
con_artist.description: A likeable, outgoing liar with a notorious trade behind them.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.description: A wanted shot with a smoking habit and a trick style.

criminal_fixer.name: Criminal Fixer
criminal_fixer.description: A wanted dealer who sells anything, including the people around them.

polyglot_spy.name: Polyglot Spy
polyglot_spy.description: Speaks every language, keeps no name, trusts nobody, works nights.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.description: A short-sighted, modest genius who has read and kept everything.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.description: Herbs, apparatus and a refusal to accept an imperfect batch.

tinker_smith.name: Tinker Smith
tinker_smith.description: Two good hands, a forge and a feel for machinery.

field_physician.name: Field Physician
field_physician.description: A studied healer with herb lore and an open purse.

cartographer.name: Cartographer
cartographer.description: Maps, languages and books, up at first light to use them.

detective.name: Detective
detective.description: A doubting eye, a perfect memory and a nose for a trail.

battlemage.name: Battlemage
battlemage.description: Gifted, sensitive and already marked by the magic they cast.

devout_pilgrim.name: Devout Pilgrim
devout_pilgrim.description: Faith, the long road and nothing owned along it.

heretic_witch.name: Heretic Witch
heretic_witch.description: Cast out, cursed, marked, and seeing further than either.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.description: Reads what has not happened yet, and fears the dark it comes out of.

nightborn.name: Nightborn
nightborn.description: Pale, cold, beautiful and awake only after dusk.

beast_whisperer.name: Beast Whisperer
beast_whisperer.description: Half wild, at home with animals and with what animals answer to.

hermit_survivalist.name: Hermit Survivalist
hermit_survivalist.description: Lives off the land, tracks anything, cannot bear a crowd.

mountain_ranger.name: Mountain Ranger
mountain_ranger.description: High-born lungs, hard legs and an early start.

farmstead_settler.name: Farmstead Settler
farmstead_settler.description: Land, animals and long days, worked without complaint.

island_sailor.name: Island Sailor
island_sailor.description: Raised on water, reads a sky, expects the best of it.

spelunker.name: Spelunker
spelunker.description: Small, night-eyed and numb to pain, at home under the rock.

travelling_bard.name: Travelling Bard
travelling_bard.description: A big voice, a bigger audience and no stranger in the room.

noble_heir.name: Noble Heir
noble_heir.description: Name, fortune, tutors and the languages that came with them.

merchant_prince.name: Merchant Prince
merchant_prince.description: Famous, moneyed, silver-tongued and never satisfied.

diplomat.name: Diplomat
diplomat.description: Many languages, plain dealing and a talent for the workable answer.

celebrated_hero.name: Celebrated Hero
celebrated_hero.description: Known everywhere for the right reasons, and aware of it.

blind_seer.name: Blind Seer
blind_seer.description: Sightless, sensitive and prophetic, afraid of the dark and of being alone.

silent_monk.name: Silent Monk
silent_monk.description: Voiceless, humble, and lethal without a weapon.

mad_arsonist.name: Mad Arsonist
mad_arsonist.description: A hot-headed, wanted nihilist who solves things with fire.

hoarder_tinker.name: Hoarder Tinker
hoarder_tinker.description: Keeps everything, fixes everything, never stops working.

degenerate_gambler.name: Degenerate Gambler
degenerate_gambler.description: Lucky, thirsty, greedy and always in for one more hand.

caffeine_insomniac.name: Caffeine Insomniac
caffeine_insomniac.description: Wired, scattered, brilliant at three in the morning.

glass_cannon.name: Glass Cannon
glass_cannon.description: A brittle body carrying far more power than it can survive.

gentle_giant.name: Gentle Giant
gentle_giant.description: Enormous, loud, generous and unwilling to hurt anyone.

tiny_terror.name: Tiny Terror
tiny_terror.description: Small, quick, spiteful and lighter fingered than anyone expects.

feral_child.name: Feral Child
feral_child.description: Raised by nothing, reads nothing, feels nothing, fears strangers.

doomsday_prepper.name: Doomsday Prepper
doomsday_prepper.description: Convinced it is coming, stocked for it, and sleeping with the light on.

gentle_ascetic.name: Gentle Ascetic
gentle_ascetic.description: Owns little, eats plainly, forgives everything, refuses to fight.
